meta.title: Causal Classifier
meta.description: Judges the causal type only: it does not generate strategies, execute, or roll back. Four questions decide between structural duality (hold simultaneously, define each other, no order), cyclic (A→B→A with delay), unidirectional (strict irreversible order), and nested (multiple structures). Confidence is capped at 0.9; below 0.7 it flags exploration; when undecidable it returns unknown with candidate hypotheses instead of forcing a label.
